entities.summary: Veli Mitova is a South African philosopher, professor and director of the African Centre for Epistemology and Philosophy of Science (ACEPS) at the University of Johannesburg. She is known for her work on epistemic decolonisation and reasons for belief, in particular truthy psychologism.
